newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador's coffee exports fell in Jan-Sept.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador's coffee exports fell in Jan-Sept.

text.p: Ecuador's coffee exports fell 12.6 percent in the first nine months of 1996 to 1.18 million 60-kg bags due to the retention plan of the Association of Coffee Producing Countries (ACPC), an exporters group said Friday.
The National Coffee Exporters Association said Ecuador shipped 1.35 million bags in the first nine months of 1995.
Meanwhile, coffee revenues fell 33.3 percent in the January-September period to $118.3 million from $177.3 million in the first nine months of 1995.
In 1995, Ecuador's coffee exports fell 23 percent to 1.9 million 60-kg bags from 2.5 million bags exported in 1994.
Ecuador plans to export 1.4 million bags between July of this year and June 1997.
Coffee is Ecuador's fifth export earner, after oil, banana, shrimp and cacao.
